verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents cross-meeting search. The pricing page lists "Meeting search", the transcripts API lets you search keywords in meeting titles and spoken words, and AskFred can query across multiple meetings. Nothing in the pack shows searching summaries or notes, or jumping to the exact moment in a recording where something was said. missing for 10: jump-to-timestamp playback from search results, explicit search over summaries and notes, independent or hands-on corroboration of in-app search depth.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can search across every past meeting — transcripts, summaries, and notes — and jump to the exact moment something was said

citations.quote: Transcribe, summarize, search, and analyze all your team conversations.
Allows searching for keywords in meeting title and/or words spoken during the meeting
Query individual meetings or search across multiple meetings to get intelligent, context-aware answers.
